twstrs-severity.l: Rotation (turning to left or right) [0 - None; 1 - Slight (1 to 22 degrees); 2 - Mild (23 to 45 degrees); 3 - Moderate (46 to 67 degrees); 4 - Severe (68 to 90 degrees)]
Laterocollis (tilt to the shoulder), excluding shoulder elevation [0 - None; 1 - Mild (1 to 15 degrees); 2 - Moderate (16 to 35 degrees); 3 - Severe (more than 35 degrees)]

Sagittal deviation — anterocollis OR retrocollis. These are mutually exclusive and share one slot; a neck cannot be flexed and extended at once. [0 - None; 1 - Mild downward or backward deviation of the chin; 2 - Moderate deviation, about half the possible range; 3 - Severe (chin reaches chest, or full backward deviation)]

Duration of the deviation. THIS ITEM IS RATED 0 to 5 AND THEN DOUBLED, contributing 0 to 10. [0 - None; 1 - Occasional deviation, under 25 percent of the time, most often submaximal; 2 - Occasional under 25 percent most often maximal, or intermittent 25 to 50 percent most often submaximal; 3 - Intermittent 25 to 50 percent often maximal, or frequent 50 to 75 percent most often submaximal; 4 - Frequent 50 to 75 percent most often maximal, or constant over 75 percent most often submaximal; 5 - Constant deviation over 75 percent of the time, often maximal]
Effect of sensory tricks [0 - Complete relief; 1 - Partial or only limited relief; 2 - Little or no benefit]

Shoulder elevation or anterior displacement [0 - Absent; 1 - Mild (under a third of the possible range), intermittent or moderate and intermittent; 2 - Moderate (a third to two thirds of the range) and constant over 75 percent of the time, or severe (over two thirds) and intermittent; 3 - Severe and constant]

Range of motion, without sensory tricks [0 - Able to move to the extreme opposite position; 1 - Well past midline but not to the extreme opposite position; 2 - Barely past midline; 3 - Toward but not past midline; 4 - Barely able to move the head beyond the abnormal posture]
Time the head can be held in neutral, without sensory tricks [0 - More than 60 seconds; 1 - 46 to 60 seconds; 2 - 31 to 45 seconds; 3 - 16 to 30 seconds; 4 - Under 15 seconds]
